artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.artist: Marcantonio Raimondi after Raphael
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 28.1 x 43.4 cm (11 1/16 x 17 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: Printed with black lines and hatching on cream-white paper, a woman clutching an infant runs toward us as muscular men attack other women holding babies to each side in front of a town in this horizonal engraving. At the far left, a woman hunches over a motionless child, her hand on the baby’s chest. A nude man nearby unsheathes a sword as he grabs the leg of a child held by a woman, who attempts to turn protectively away. A kneeling woman to the right braces her child behind her back and reaches up to defend herself against a man swinging a sword back to strike. Another man pulls a woman’s hair in the background and a third stabs a woman in the chest as she clutches her child to her other shoulder. Two more baby boys lie already dead underfoot. The people are closely packed and overlapping, and many reach or gesture upward or outward. The scene takes place on a paved or stone town square in front of an arching bridge. Stone structures rise beyond the bridge, and clouds skim across the otherwise blank sky. On the stone wall to the left, there is a rectangular plaque inscribed with “RAPH VRBI INVE” and the initials MA intertwined.

artworks.title: Alexander and Thaïs Setting Fire to Persepolis
artworks.artist: Lodovico Carracci
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white heightening on paper washed orange-brown
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures in a dynamic pose. Both individuals are standing, facing each other. One figure on the left has an outstretched arm. They are wearing a helmet with a plume and scant armor, while the figure on the right is adorned in flowing garments. The scene appears to be set indoors, with subtle architectural lines in the background and an indistinct depiction of people or statues in the distance. The drawing emphasizes the contours and form of the clothing and bodies.

artworks.title: Studies of a Holy Family
artworks.artist: Cesare Pollini
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and pink wash, heightened with white gouache, on laid paper washed sanguine
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures, including seated adults with infants and flying cherubs. The composition includes central seated adults with surrounding infants, some being held and others flying. The outlines have detailed expressions and drapery folds with dynamic strokes. The background features sketches of small cherub-like figures. The color palette is muted with earthy tones and highlights.

artworks.title: Title Page: Pedestal and a Pair of Dogs
artworks.artist: Jan Fyt
artworks.description: This is an image of a dedication plaque set in a natural scene. The plaque is adorned with foliated designs including leaves and possibly classical figures or mythical creatures. There is text on the plaque dedicating it to an individual with several titles. A boar is depicted on the left near a tree trunk, and two dogs stand to the right of the plaque. The scene is surrounded by detailed sketches of shrubbery and natural elements. The drawing showcases fine linear techniques to create contrast and texture.

artworks.title: Four Dogs, One Sleeping beside a Capital
artworks.artist: Jan Fyt
artworks.description: The image depicts a rough-textured structure resembling an archway or tunnel. The scene shows a tunnel vision effect pointing towards the center where two dogs are located. The horizon is not visible, focusing on the interior of a ruin or cave-like space. Brushstrokes are meticulous, with cross-hatching creating texture and depth in the arch and the fur of the animals. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black. A fallen column and stones are on the ground. In the background, more stonework and a wooden fence are visible, adding to the sense of an ancient or forgotten place.

artworks.title: Two Greyhounds, Leashed and Facing Opposite Directions
artworks.artist: Jan Fyt
artworks.description: Two animals are depicted in a detailed drawing in a rocky natural setting. The animals are engaged in a dynamic interaction, with one recoiling upwards while the other bites its neck. The background features textured shrubbery and small trees, adding depth to the scene. The monochrome palette of the drawing adds a classic and timeless feel, emphasizing form and composition over color.

artworks.title: Two Beagles, One Sleeping
artworks.artist: Jan Fyt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two dogs in a natural setting. The illustration depicts two dogs, one standing alertly while the other is lying down. The drawing utilizes intricate line work to convey texture in the dogs' fur and the surrounding elements, such as the foliage, tree branches, and ground. In the background, there is a suggestion of dense plants or grasses and a leafless tree. The artist's use of cross-hatching and fine lines creates a sense of realism and detail, particularly in rendering the animals and their environment.

artworks.title: Two Greyhounds, Leashed and Facing Each Other
artworks.artist: Jan Fyt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three dogs. Two dogs are standing and pulling on a leash, while a third dog is lying down. The background shows trees, a distant structure, and a lightly textured sky. The drawing is detailed, with fine lines depicting the dogs' fur and muscles, and the rough ground they are on. The scene appears to capture a pause in the dogs' activity.

artworks.title: Two Dogs Copulating
artworks.artist: Jan Fyt
artworks.description: The image features two dogs on a rocky slope. The horizon is low in the composition, with foliage and trees in the distance. The artwork has sketch-like brushstrokes, showcasing intricate details of the dogs and natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown. A stone structure, a statue, tall trees, and clouds are also visible.

artworks.title: Two Mastiffs beside a Fountain
artworks.artist: Jan Fyt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two dogs resting near a fountain in a landscape. The drawing depicts two large dogs with intricate fur texture details. They are positioned by a fountain with elaborate decorations, including a water-spouting figure. The background shows a natural setting with lush foliage, a tree, and distant hills. In the background, there are towers and architectural structures hinting at a nearby settlement or town. Fine lines and shading are used to add depth and texture to the image.

artworks.title: Landscape with Greyhound and Rifle
artworks.artist: Jan Fyt
artworks.description: This drawing shows a dog in a landscape. The dog is standing on rocky terrain with a backdrop of rugged rocks and trees. There are detailed renderings of foliage and branches in the foreground. The artist used cross-hatching for shading and detail, creating depth and naturalism. The sky above is lightly etched, suggesting openness. The dog appears attentive. This drawing is in the style of Stefano della Bella.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing on the right playing bagpipes. Behind them is a winding path, a large tree, and a small church-like structure in the distance on the left. A cartwheel rests against a gate. The engraving showcases fine lines depicting textures of clothing, tree leaves, and a thatched building. The color scheme is monochrome focusing on contrast. Latin text is displayed on a board near the figure.

artworks.title: Town Gate
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a tall, medieval-style tower on the right side. The horizon is low, with buildings extending into the distance on the left. The artwork is executed in pen and ink with intricate, precise lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic with black ink on a light paper background, highlighting the details. Two small figures walk along a path with a waterway nearby reflecting the buildings, and ducks are on the water. The sky has a few birds and wispy clouds.

artworks.title: Village Road
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a path leading to village structures surrounded by trees and shrubs. The etching technique features fine lines and shading for texture of thatched roofs and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly black and beige. Birds can be seen in the sky.

artworks.title: Village Road
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a dirt path leading into a wooded area. The horizon is low, and a small figure is walking along the path. Three thatched-roof buildings are to the right. The trees and foliage are detailed with fine lines, creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on a light backdrop. Bushes and trees are on the left. In the lower right corner, a small figure on horseback is accompanied by a dog.

artworks.title: A Farmyard
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of thatched roof buildings surrounded by trees. The viewpoint is from ground level, highlighting the roofs, trees, and sky. The artwork appears to be an intricate pen and ink drawing with detailed line work showing textures. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black and gray on a light background. A path leads through the village, partially hidden by trees, towards more buildings and trees in the distance. The scene portrays a quiet rural setting with a focus on architectural and natural details.

artworks.title: The Swann's Inn
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with trees, buildings, figures engaged in conversation, and a person sitting near a basket. One of the buildings has a round emblem with a rooster on it, and there are trees surrounding the area. The sketch is done in fine, precise lines typical of etching, creating texture and shade. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a light background.

artworks.title: Village Road
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a dirt path leading from the foreground towards a village in the distance. The horizon is low, showcasing the sky with flying birds. In the center, thatched-roof houses are surrounded by detailed trees. The artwork is monochromatic, emphasizing textures and details. A group of figures is gathered near the path.

artworks.title: Farms in a Village
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with thatched-roofed buildings in a village. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing the village against the sky. The artwork uses fine etching lines for detail and texture. The lines vary in density to show shading and texture, especially on the roofs and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, with black lines on a light background. A man is seen drawing water from a well, with a dog nearby. More buildings and trees are visible, creating a dense village setting.

artworks.title: The Pond
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a village with a stone tower at its center and thatched houses lined up beyond it. The scene is depicted with fine etching strokes, creating texture and shadow. The color palette is monochrome, with black ink on light paper. In the foreground, there is a pond with a figure fishing, and a boat nearby. In the background, there are trees, with birds flying in the sky.

artworks.title: Large Farm
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rural buildings, trees, and a sky with clouds. The roofs of the buildings are visible from a slightly elevated perspective. Trees of various heights partially obstruct the view of the buildings. The horizon is marked by a line of trees. The sky above has clouds and birds in motion. The image is created using an etching technique, with fine lines detailing texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black lines on a cream background to depict light and shadow. A dirt path in the foreground adds depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Walled Farm
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a rustic scene with gabled-roof buildings within a stone wall enclosure. Trees line the horizon beyond the buildings. The drawing style is detailed, with cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is mainly black, gray, and beige. A path leads to the gates with trees framing the entrance. The sky contains clouds and distant birds.

artworks.title: Village Road
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene from a slightly elevated angle. The sky occupies a significant part of the image, featuring delicate lines suggesting clouds. Birds are seen near the horizon. In the foreground, there is a winding dirt path leading to thatched-roof buildings surrounded by fences and trees. The trees are detailed with cross-hatching. A figure is visible near the path. The image is in black and white, resembling an etching with precise line work defining the landscape.

artworks.title: A Convent
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The artwork features a rural scene with two figures walking along a path. The horizon is low, showing a detailed tree line and a distant church with a spire. Trees of different heights and densities create a barrier before the structures. The linework style is detailed with cross-hatchings and parallel lines. The monochromatic palette uses various shades for contrast. The sky is lightly detailed with cloud shapes, and small birds fly in the distance.
